affectedDataViewsModal.description: Their drafts show it already; their viewers keep seeing the published version until it's published again.
affectedDataViewsModal.otherChanges: Has other unpublished changes - publish it from its own page.
affectedDataViewsModal.title: Published DataViews this change reaches

bindingButton.examplesDescription: Click any row to insert it at the cursor/selection. Result is computed live against one fixed sample record.
bindingButton.modalDescription: A formula evaluated against this record's own field values - falls back to {label}'s static value above when empty or unparseable.

problems.denied: Camera permission was denied - allow it in the browser to use it.
problems.failed: The camera could not be opened.
problems.insecure: The browser opens the camera only over HTTPS (or on localhost).
problems.missing: No camera was found on this device.
problems.unsupported: This browser has no camera access.

accept.description: File types to accept, e.g. image/*,.pdf
accept.label: Accepted types

actions.description: Icon buttons at the end of each row - Action clicked tells which by its Name; each may be off or hidden by a formula per row.
actions.label: Row actions

align.description: Its text and buttons, left to right.
align.label: Align content

arrow.description: A small arrow pointing at what opened it.
arrow.label: Arrow

autoresize.description: Gets taller as the text grows, instead of scrolling.
autoresize.label: Grow with its text

avatar.description: Its avatar's image URL - empty shows the name's initials.
avatar.label: Image

background.description: Its box's color - the theme's, light and dark.
background.label: Background

block.description: Its input fills the field - set the field's width and the input follows.
block.label: Full width

calendar.description: A calendar button beside the field - its days stop at the column's CHECK bounds; a timestamp's time below it. Typing stays.
calendar.label: Calendar

close.description: An ✕ in its corner that closes it.
close.label: Close button

color.description: One of the theme's colors - primary, error, success...
color.label: Color

colorKey.description: Each option's icon color, one of the theme's (primary, success, warning...) - a field, or a formula: {'{'}{'{'}balance{'}'}{'}'} < 0 ? "error" : "success".
colorKey.label: Color field

column.description: A column of the page's record: its input edits record.data.<column>. PostgreSQL's NOT NULL makes it required, and it's read-only where the viewer may not write it.
column.label: Linked by

columnSettings.description: Each column's title, format and look - what isn't set comes from its resource's column. In its Rows' order; a hidden one still comes with Row clicked's row.
columnSettings.label: Columns

columns.description: Options per row - the rest wrap below. Two per row on a phone.
columns.label: Columns

computedColumns.description: A formula per row - {'{'}{'{'}quantity{'}'}{'}'} * {'{'}{'{'}unit_price{'}'}{'}'} - shown after its Rows' fields; its look in Columns. A total that must add up belongs in PostgreSQL.
computedColumns.label: Computed columns

createItem.description: Options from a Resource: typing a value it doesn't list offers Create - a new row of its table with that value in its Label field, saved as the viewer (their CREATE permission), then picked. PostgreSQL decides whether the row is valid.
createItem.label: Create from search

cssClass.description: Tailwind classes on its box, beyond the Style tab's - spacing, text, layout.
cssClass.label: CSS classes

dashboard.description: A published Dashboard. Who sees it is its own: a viewer without access sees it isn't available.
dashboard.label: Dashboard

dataview.description: A published DataView over the detail table: its grid shows the rows, its record form edits each one.
dataview.label: DataView

descriptionKey.description: Shown muted beneath the label - a field, or a formula over its fields.
descriptionKey.label: Description field

disabled.description: Shown greyed out - it can't be used.
disabled.label: Disabled

disabledKey.description: Turns an option off - a true/false field, or a formula over its fields and the page: {'{'}{'{'}id{'}'}{'}'} == 5 && !{'{'}{'{'}vars.customer.data.active{'}'}{'}'}.
disabledKey.label: Disabled field

dismissible.description: Closes when the viewer clicks outside it.
dismissible.label: Close on outside click

expandable.description: A button that grows it to almost the whole screen.
expandable.label: Expand button

fillHeight.description: Takes the height the page has left, so everything fits on screen - a Detail's rows, an editor. Its own height is then the least it takes.
fillHeight.label: Fill height

filter.description: A search box above the options.
filter.label: Filter box

granularity.description: A timestamp's: to the minute when unset. A date column is always to the day.
granularity.label: Precision

highlight.description: Outlined in its color, to draw attention.
highlight.label: Highlight

htmlAttrs.description: Extra attributes on the widget, e.g. data-test or title.
htmlAttrs.label: HTML attributes

iconKey.description: Each option's icon, e.g. i-lucide-banknote - a field, or a formula over its fields.
iconKey.label: Icon field

iconSize.description: Each option's icon - from sm to 2xl; empty keeps Nuxt UI's.
iconSize.label: Icon size

indicator.description: Where its dot sits - hidden shows each option's icon instead, as cards do.
indicator.label: Indicator

inset.description: Floats with a margin from the edge of the screen.
inset.label: Inset

items.description: Its label may be a formula - "Items (" + {'{'}{'{'}vars.items.count{'}'}{'}'} + ")"; one off until a customer is picked, another shown only to some.
items.label: Options

keepActive.label: Hidden, still active
keepActive.description: Hidden by Visible, it stays on the page unseen - its methods and what it listens to keep working: a scanner listening to the page, a modal opened by code.

labelKey.description: The field shown for each option - or a formula over its fields, e.g. {'{'}{'{'}sku{'}'}{'}'} + " - " + {'{'}{'{'}name{'}'}{'}'}; its Resource must read them.
labelKey.label: Label field

loading.description: Shows a spinner while something is busy.
loading.label: Loading

loadingAuto.description: Its submit button shows loading while the submit handler runs.
loadingAuto.label: Busy while submitting

mask.description: Hides what is typed, like a password.
mask.label: Mask

modelValue.description: A Value variable it reads and writes - or a formula (the link): shown read only, written nowhere, e.g. {'{'}{'{'}controls.selectCustomer.item.tax_id{'}'}{'}'}.
modelValue.label: Value

multiple.description: Picks several options - its value is a list.
multiple.label: Multiple

name.description: Its value's key in the form's data - by convention the column it saves to. Empty: its column, else the input's variable.
name.label: Name

openInNewTab.description: A button above it that opens the same page in a new tab.
openInNewTab.label: Open in new tab

orientation.description: Laid out in a row or in a column.
orientation.label: Orientation

pager.description: Pages through its Rows' Resource on the server - its limit is the page size; with Count the total, too.
pager.label: Pager

paging.description: Off: every row at once - a record's items.
paging.label: Pages

editInline.label: Edit in the grid
editInline.description: Linked by a column: its rows edited in place - Tab from cell to cell, Tab past the last adds one - and saved with the page's record, in one transaction. Off: each row in its own form.

pattern.description: A regular expression (JavaScript) the whole value must match - checked as the viewer types, with the column's own CHECK. PostgreSQL still decides on save; an empty value is left to Required.
pattern.label: Pattern

patternMessage.description: Shown under the field when the value doesn't match. Empty: Invalid format.
patternMessage.label: Pattern message

range.description: Picks a start and an end date.
range.label: Date range

readOnly.description: No New, editing or deleting here - an issued invoice's items: {'{'}{'{'}vars.record.data.status{'}'}{'}'} == "ISSUED".
readOnly.label: Read only

required.description: Needs a value before the form submits - a NOT NULL column already does.
required.label: Required

rowColorKey.description: Tints each row - a field holding a palette color (red, green...), or a formula: {'{'}{'{'}vencida{'}'}{'}'} ? "red" : "".
rowColorKey.label: Row color

scrollable.description: The whole modal scrolls, not only its body.
scrollable.label: Scroll the whole modal

search.description: A search box over its Rows' Resource - the server searches its text fields.
search.label: Search

searchBlock.description: The search box as wide as the table - in a modal or a sidebar.
searchBlock.label: Full-width search

searchWindow.label: Search window
searchWindow.description: Options from a Resource: a 🔍 beside it opens them as a table - its Resource's fields as columns, searched and paged on the server - to pick one by any of them. For long lists.

searchWindowAs.label: Search window as
searchWindowAs.description: Where the search window opens - a sidebar (the default, room for a long list) or a modal. Full screen on a phone.

shadow.description: Lifts its box off the page.
shadow.label: Shadow

size.description: From xs to xl - Default is md.
size.label: Size

square.description: As wide as it is tall - for an icon alone.
square.label: Square

startExpanded.description: Opens at almost the whole screen - for content that needs the room.
startExpanded.label: Open expanded

status.description: Shows the value as a number beside the bar.
status.label: Show the value

sticky.description: The column titles stay in view while scrolling.
sticky.label: Sticky header

title.description: What the frame shows, for screen readers.
title.label: Title

tooltip.description: Shows the value above the handle while dragging.
tooltip.label: Tooltip

type.description: The browser's own input for it - datetime-local shows a timestamp with time zone in the viewer's.
type.label: Type

url.description: https://… - a value goes where a token is: https://tracking.example/shipments/{'{'}{'{'}vars.record.data.tracking_id{'}'}{'}'}. The site itself is fixed (tokens only after the / that follows it), each value is URL-encoded, and the values are sent to that site.
url.label: URL

validate.description: A Code function (dataview, {'{'} data {'}'}) returning {'{'} errors: [{'{'} field, message {'}'}] {'}'} - may be async.
validate.label: Validate

valueKey.description: The field of each option that is stored - its primary key by default.
valueKey.label: Value field

variables.description: A formula per variable, e.g. {'{'}{'{'}vars.record.data.id{'}'}{'}'} - set ones are hidden from its bar; the rest stay the viewer's to pick.
variables.label: Variables

verticalAlign.description: Where it sits in its row, beside a taller widget - stretch: a Card or a Box takes the row's height, even with the one beside it.
verticalAlign.label: Vertical align

visible.description: Off - or a formula giving false - it leaves the page: no space, and its methods (dataview.controls.<name>.open()) and what it listens to (a Scanner's USB reader) stop. Hidden, still active keeps it working unseen.
visible.label: Visible

searchWindowSize.label: Search window size
searchWindowSize.description: Its width - unset, Nuxt UI's own (a narrow sidebar or modal); sm to xl as a record form's sizes, xl for a wide table. Full screen on a phone from md.

clearForm.description: Removes the messages its validation left.
clearForm.label: Clear a form's errors

confirmThen.description: Stops unless the viewer confirms - then runs another snippet.
confirmThen.label: Ask for confirmation, then…

copyToClipboard.description: The event's value or a fixed text, with a notification.
copyToClipboard.label: Copy to the clipboard

value.description: When What is a fixed text.
value.label: Fixed text

filterResource.description: A runtime filter on one column, AND-ed with its designed where - an empty value clears it.
filterResource.label: Filter a Resource by a value

variable.description: When Value is a Value variable.
variable.label: Value variable

focusInput.description: Puts the cursor in it - after opening a modal, or when a check fails.
focusInput.label: Focus an input

openDataView.description: Goes to it - with this record's key as its ?pk=, which opens that record there.
openDataView.label: Open another DataView

withRecord.description: Only on a page with a record.
withRecord.label: Pass this record's key (pk)

openLink.description: A URL, here or in a new tab.
openLink.label: Open a link

recordAction.description: New, undo the changes, delete (asks first), clone or reread the record.
recordAction.label: A record action

options.clone: Copy it into a new one

refreshData.description: Reads a Resource again - every widget bound to it updates.
refreshData.label: Refresh data

runCall.description: Executes a Call, then opens its file or tells the viewer; a failure shows its message.
runCall.label: Run a workflow or function

options.event: The event - a form's submit, {'{'} data {'}'}

openFile.description: A print or a PDF: {'{'} asset {'}'} or {'{'} mimeType, content {'}'}.
openFile.label: Open the result as a file

saveRecord.description: Saves it; if PostgreSQL says no, the viewer sees why and the record stays as it was.
saveRecord.label: Save the record

searchResource.description: The event's value (what was typed) as the Resource's search.
searchResource.label: Search a Resource

setRecordColumn.description: Puts a value in one of the record's columns - the event's, or a fixed one. Saved with the record.
setRecordColumn.label: Set a column of the record

value.description: When To is a fixed value.
value.label: Fixed value

setVariable.description: Puts a value in a Value - the event's, or a fixed one.
setVariable.label: Set a variable

value.description: When To is a fixed value.
value.label: Fixed value

submitForm.description: Validates it and emits its submit - as its submit button would.
submitForm.label: Submit a form

toggleOverlay.description: By the name it has in the Design form.
toggleOverlay.label: Open or close a modal or slideover

useSelectedRow.description: On a Table's select: puts one of the row's fields in a Value.
useSelectedRow.label: Use the selected row

field.description: A field the Table's Resource reads - id, nombre…
field.label: Field of the row

date_range.description: A calendar period (this month, last year…) or two dates.
date_range.label: Date range

time.description: A time of day, HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
time.label: Time

CALL.description: A function, a MANUAL workflow or a table write, run on demand as the viewer.

expose.execute: Runs it - with input, instead of the designed one; resolves to the result, rejects on failure.

CALL.label: Call

input.description: The request body: {'{'} "data": {'{'}...{'}'} {'}'}; a table update or delete also names its row - "pk" or "where". Values may use {'{'}{'{'}vars.*{'}'}{'}'}.
input.label: Input

target.description: A function, a MANUAL workflow, or a table to create, update or delete rows in.
target.label: Target

error.description: The last failure, as the API's {'{'} errors: [{'{'} code, message {'}'}] {'}'}, or null.
error.label: Error

RECORD.description: A row of the DataView's source table - loaded, edited and saved through the Data API as the viewer.

expose.clone: A new record with its values - not its key or generated columns.
expose.close: Closes the page or panel it's open in.
expose.delete: Deletes it, after a confirmation; resolves to whether it did.
expose.new: Starts a new record, with values.
expose.open: Opens another row by its key - read-only with view, until edit().
expose.refresh: Reads it again, keeping the edits - what a trigger recomputed shows up (a Detail's rowsChanged).
expose.reload: Reads it again, dropping the edits.
expose.save: Saves it, with values set first; resolves to false when it didn't - the record is then left as it was.

RECORD.label: Record

data.description: The row's values, edits included - data.<column>.
data.label: Data

dirty.description: true while it has unsaved changes.
dirty.label: Unsaved changes

error.description: The last failure, as the API's {'{'} errors: [{'{'} code, message {'}'}] {'}'}, or null.
error.label: Error

pk.description: The primary key's value - null for a new record.
pk.label: Key

RESOURCE.description: Read-only data from a table or view, through the Data API and the viewer's permissions.

expose.find: The row whose column equals value, read apart - data stays as it is; null if none.
expose.refresh: Runs the query again; resolves to data.
expose.setFilter: A runtime filter, AND-ed with the designed where.

RESOURCE.label: Resource

query.description: Fields (required), where, search, group by, aggregates, order and limit.
query.label: Query

resource.description: A table or view exposed for GET.
resource.label: Resource

count.description: The total, when Count is on.
count.label: Count

limit.description: Its query's limit - null when it has none.
limit.label: Page size

page.description: The page it read, from 1 - setPage() moves it, a new search or filter goes back to 1.
page.label: Page

search.description: What setSearch() set (a Table's search box) - null without one, the query's own search then.
search.label: Search

VALUE.description: Page state - what the viewer picked or typed, or what code set.

expose.set: Sets the value, coerced to the variable's type.

VALUE.label: Value

default.description: A constant, a formula, a URL parameter or a field of the viewer ($USER).
default.label: Default

value.description: The current value, of the variable's type.
value.label: Value

item.description: The chosen option's whole row - its fields as .campo; null with none (or several).
item.label: Item

row.description: The last row clicked - its fields as .campo; null until one is.
row.label: Row

TBox.description: A plain area grouping widgets - no frame of its own: its look is its Style (padding, border, background, radius).
TBox.label: Box

fillHeight.description: Takes the height the page or panel has left - what it holds scrolls inside it (a Card's body, between its header and footer). A widget in it with Fill height fills it.

TCamera.description: Takes a photo with the device's camera, crops and compresses it, and stores it as a file - for a file column, like a person's photo.
TCamera.label: Camera

aspect.description: original keeps the photo as framed. A ratio crops it to that shape (1:1 square, 3:4 portrait).
aspect.label: Crop

facing.description: environment: the back camera. user: the front one. The viewer can switch.
facing.label: Camera

label.description: The button's text - empty: Take photo.
label.label: Button

maxSize.description: In pixels - a larger photo is scaled down to it (default 1600).
maxSize.label: Largest side

quality.description: JPEG quality from 0.1 to 1 (default 0.85) - lower, a smaller file.
quality.label: Quality

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: The button's icon - unset: a camera.

TColorSelect.description: A palette color or any hex color.
TColorSelect.label: Color

TDashboard.description: A published Dashboard, its variables set from the page - a customer's own figures, for one.
TDashboard.label: Dashboard

TDataView.label: DataView
TDataView.description: Another DataView inside the page - its grid, cards, map, board, calendar or timeline, its New and its record form. Linked by a column: the rows that belong to the page's record (an order's items, a person's history); without: every row its own filter allows.

dataview.label: DataView
dataview.description: A published DataView. Its viewers' permissions decide what they read and write in it.

column.label: Linked by
column.description: The rows that belong to the page's record: only those whose column points at it, a new row starts linked to it, and nothing shows until the record is saved. Empty: every row.

view.label: View
view.description: Which of the DataView's views it shows - empty: the one it opens with.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Each of its columns shown or hidden here - their format is the DataView's. Empty: as the DataView shows them.

paging.label: Pages
paging.description: Off: every row at once - a record's items.

editInline.label: Edit in the grid
editInline.description: Linked by a column: its rows edited in place - Tab from cell to cell, Tab past the last adds one - and saved with the page's record, in one transaction. Off: each row in its own form.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Nothing but reading here, whatever Allow says - an issued invoice's items: {'{'}{'{'}vars.record.data.status{'}'}{'}'} == "ISSUED".

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: What it lets a viewer do besides reading - only less than their permissions and than the DataView it shows allows, never more. Empty: all three.

toolbarMode.label: Toolbar
toolbarMode.description: none: only New; compact: search and a menu; full: every action a button. A phone is always compact.

tools.label: Toolbar functions
tools.description: Each of its toolbar's functions, on or off here - only off what the DataView has on.

TDrawer.description: A panel rising from the bottom - TotalBase's own drawer, for working on something with room.
TDrawer.label: Drawer

size.description: Its width, from sm to xl - lg by default, as every drawer in TotalBase.

TFrame.description: Another site's page in a sandboxed frame - its URL may take values from the page, e.g. the record's tracking number.
TFrame.label: Frame

TJson.description: Structured data, edited as a tree.
TJson.label: JSON

TRangeInput.description: A PostgreSQL range - from and to, with the date or number inputs its type takes; empty, no value.
TRangeInput.label: Range

TLeafletMap.description: A point picked on an OpenStreetMap map.
TLeafletMap.label: Map (Leaflet)

TScanner.description: Reads a QR code, a PDF417 (a DNI) or a barcode - with the device's camera or a USB reader in keyboard mode - and emits what it read.
TScanner.label: Scanner

beep.description: A short tone on each read.
beep.label: Beep

camera.description: A button that opens the camera to read a code. The browser allows it only over HTTPS (or on localhost).
camera.label: Camera

continuous.description: The camera stays open after a read, for the next one.
continuous.label: Keep reading

formats.description: The codes the camera reads, comma-separated - empty: all of them (qr_code, pdf417, code_128, ean_13...).
formats.label: Formats

input.description: A field where a USB reader types (or a person does) - Enter reads it.
input.label: Text field

label.description: The camera button's text - empty: an icon only.
label.label: Camera button

listen.description: field: what is typed in its text field. page: a reader's burst of keys anywhere on the page, with nothing focused - for a kiosk.
listen.label: USB reader

modelValue.description: A Value variable that keeps the last code read (or a record column it fills).
modelValue.label: Value

vibrate.description: A short vibration on each read, where the device can.
vibrate.label: Vibrate

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: The camera button's icon - unset: a barcode.

TText.description: A paragraph - its content can be a formula.
TText.label: Text

UAccordion.description: Sections that expand one (or several) at a time.
UAccordion.label: Accordion

items.description: Its label may be a formula; one off or hidden by a formula over the page.
items.label: Sections

modelValue.description: A Value holding the open section's key - a list of them with Open: multiple. Set it from Code to open one.
modelValue.label: Open sections

UAlert.description: A message with a title and a description.
UAlert.label: Alert

UAvatar.description: An image, initials or an icon in a circle.
UAvatar.label: Avatar

UButton.description: Runs a Code function on click.
UButton.label: Button

block.description: Fills the width of its container.

type.description: Submit sends the form it is in.

UCard.description: A framed section with a header and a footer.
UCard.label: Card

fillHeight.description: Takes the height the page or panel has left - what it holds scrolls inside it (a Card's body, between its header and footer). A widget in it with Fill height fills it.

UCheckboxGroup.description: Pick any number of options, all visible.
UCheckboxGroup.label: Checkbox group

UCollapsible.description: A trigger that shows or hides its content.
UCollapsible.label: Collapsible

UDropdownMenu.description: A menu of actions under its trigger - each item runs a Code function.
UDropdownMenu.label: Dropdown menu

items.description: Each runs its Code function - Cancel off once it's paid, Delete only for some: a formula over the page.
items.label: Items

UEditor.description: A rich text editor - Markdown, HTML or JSON content.
UEditor.label: Rich text

UEmpty.description: An icon, a title and a description for "nothing here yet".
UEmpty.label: Empty state

UFileUpload.description: A single uploaded file or image.
UFileUpload.label: File upload

aspect.description: With Show the image: original keeps the image's own shape; a ratio frames it (3:4 portrait - a carnet photo).
aspect.label: Image shape

height.description: In pixels, whatever the screen: the empty area's - to line it up with the cards beside it - and, with Show the image, the image's (with a shape its width follows, centered; without, it spans the field; it covers the frame).
height.label: Height

preview.description: An image shows itself across the field instead of its name - tapping it picks another. Read only, it is only the image.
preview.label: Show the image

label.label: Label
label.description: The empty field's text - the area's, or the button variant's. Unset: Drop a file here or click to browse.

description.label: Description
description.description: A line under the area's text.

buttonLabel.label: Button
buttonLabel.description: The area variant: a button under its text (Upload file), for whoever doesn't know the area can be tapped.

UForm.description: Groups fields: checks the required ones and emits submit with {'{'} data {'}'} - the fields' values by name.
UForm.label: Form

UFormField.description: A labelled field around one input: label, help, required.
UFormField.label: Form field

labelWidth.description: Horizontal: the label takes this share of the field and the input the rest - set the same on fields beside each other and their values line up. A phone stacks it, label above.
labelWidth.label: Label width

junction.label: Junction table
junction.description: Instead of a column: a junction table between the page's record and another table. Its input picks several of the other table's rows, and the record's Save adds and removes the junction's rows, as the viewer, in the same transaction.

UInputDate.description: A date, a date and time, or a date range.
UInputDate.label: Date

UInputNumber.description: A number, with increment and decrement buttons.
UInputNumber.label: Number

UInputRating.description: A star rating out of a fixed maximum.
UInputRating.label: Rating

UInputTags.description: A free-form list of short text values.
UInputTags.label: Tags

UInputTime.description: A time of day, or a time range.
UInputTime.label: Time

range.description: Picks a start and an end time.
range.label: Time range

UListbox.description: A visible, filterable list to pick from.
UListbox.label: Listbox

size.description: Its width, from sm to xl - unset, Nuxt UI's own.

UPinInput.description: A short code with a fixed number of characters.
UPinInput.label: PIN input

UPopover.description: A small panel anchored to its trigger.
UPopover.label: Popover

URadioGroup.description: Pick one of a few options, all visible.
URadioGroup.label: Radio group

iconKey.description: Each option's icon, e.g. i-lucide-banknote - a field, or a formula over its fields. Shown above its label when Indicator is hidden.

UScrollArea.description: A box with its own height that scrolls what it holds - its look from the Style tab.
UScrollArea.label: Scroll area

USelect.description: Pick from a short list - no search.
USelect.label: Select

USelectMenu.description: Pick from a list, with search.
USelectMenu.label: Select menu

USeparator.description: A rule between sections, with an optional label.
USeparator.label: Separator

USlideover.description: A panel sliding in from an edge.
USlideover.label: Slideover

size.description: Its width, from sm to xl - unset, Nuxt UI's own.

USlider.description: A number picked along a bounded range.
USlider.label: Slider

USplitter.description: Panels side by side, or one above the other - the viewer drags what's between them; each panel scrolls on its own.
USplitter.label: Splitter

disabled.description: The panels keep their sizes - nothing to drag.
disabled.label: Locked

items.description: One per panel - its label names it on the canvas; its size and minimum in % of the whole, the sizes summing to 100 (changing one reshares the rest); Collapsible lets the viewer drag it shut.
items.label: Panels

UTable.description: Rows of a Resource - its columns are the Resource's fields.
UTable.label: Table

UTabs.description: Sections one at a time, under a tab strip.
UTabs.label: Tabs

modelValue.description: A Value holding the open tab's key - set it from Code to switch tabs; empty opens the first.
modelValue.label: Open tab

UTooltip.description: A hint shown over its content on hover.
UTooltip.label: Tooltip

UUser.description: A name and a description beside an avatar.
UUser.label: User

TSignature.label: Signature
TSignature.description: A pad to sign on with a finger or the mouse - stored as a PNG file, its value the file's id, like a Camera's. Clear starts over; a few ink colors. In a modal behind a button, with the signature shown on the page by a read-only Signature or Camera on the same column.

height.label: Height
height.description: The pad's height in pixels (default 180) - it takes the field's width.

colors.label: Ink colors
colors.description: A few colors to pick the ink from - off: black only.

readonly.label: Read only
readonly.description: The signature shown, never changed - no pad, no Clear.

TImage.label: Image
TImage.description: An image - one uploaded here, a file of the record ({'{'}{'{'}vars.record.data.foto{'}'}{'}'}) or a URL; with its caption, an icon or a text when there's none, and Clicked to use it as a button.

src.label: Image
src.description: A file's id or an https URL. Uploaded here, it's a public file - anyone who opens the page sees it. A formula: a file column of the record, {'{'}{'{'}vars.record.data.foto{'}'}{'}'}.

alt.label: Alternative text
alt.description: What it shows, for a screen reader - and if it can't load.

aspect.label: Shape
aspect.description: original keeps the image's own shape; a ratio frames it.

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: In a frame: contain shows all of it; cover fills it, cropping.

height.label: Height
height.description: In pixels - unset: its width and shape decide.

maxWidth.label: Largest width
maxWidth.description: In pixels - unset: the field's width.

emptyIcon.label: Icon when empty
emptyIcon.description: Shown when there's no image - unset: a picture icon.

corners.label: Corners
corners.description: How round the image's corners are - full: a circle (or a pill). The Style tab's Radius rounds its box.

TResult.description: A large panel for an outcome at a glance - a color, an icon, a title and a description, with a tone and a vibration - shown by the page's Code with dataview.controls.<name>.show(); it goes back to waiting on its own after Reset after seconds.
TResult.label: Result

idleTitle.label: Waiting title
idleTitle.description: What it says while waiting for a result - unset: Ready.

idleDescription.label: Waiting description
idleDescription.description: A line under it while waiting - e.g. Scan your code.

idleIcon.label: Waiting icon
idleIcon.description: Its icon while waiting - unset: a scan frame.

idleColor.label: Waiting color
idleColor.description: Its color while waiting - one of the theme's colors.

resetAfter.label: Reset after
resetAfter.description: Seconds a result stays before it goes back to waiting - 0: until the next one or reset(). show({ resetAfter }) may change it for one result.

variant.label: Variant
variant.description: How a result fills the panel: solid, outline, soft or subtle. Waiting, it is always soft.

size.label: Size
size.description: Its icon and text, from md to xl.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: A tone with each result - a rising one for success, a low one for error and warning; show({ sound }) may choose.

vibrate.label: Vibrate
vibrate.description: A vibration with each result, where the device can - longer for an error.

controls.description: A placed widget with a Name.

entries.form: A Form: validate and submit, validate only, clear its errors; its data as {data}.
entries.open: A Modal, a Slideover, a Popover; an input's focus.
entries.result: A Result: show an outcome - a color, an icon, a title, a description -, back to waiting now.
entries.locate: A map field or a Location: the device's position into its value.

controls.title: Controls - {code}

handlers.description: A function the page or a widget calls - pick it in an Events tab or in Page events.

entries.handler: May be async - it is awaited. event: what happened (a value, an item, a row). A handler that throws shows its message to the viewer; the page keeps working.
entries.onLoad: Runs once the page has loaded its record and its immediate Resources.

handlers.title: Handlers

entries.confirm: The page's own dialog - true when confirmed. A text, or {shape}.
entries.format: With the instance's formats and time zone.
entries.notify: A toast - success, info, warning, error, neutral.
entries.openFile: Shows a Call's file (a PDF, an image) to print or download.
entries.device: The device's position - {'{'} lng, lat, accuracy {'}'}; rejects with reason: insecure, unsupported, denied, unavailable, timeout.

record.description: The page's row, when the DataView has a source table.

entries.canEdit: Whether this viewer may write the column now.
entries.data: Its values (edits included), its key, create / edit / view, unsaved changes.
entries.other: Another record, read-only until edit() with view.
entries.refresh: Reads it again - refresh keeps the edits in progress (totals a trigger recomputed), reload drops them.
entries.save: Saves, with values set first - one step. Resolves to false when it didn't save; the form shows PostgreSQL's reason.

record.title: The record - {code}

entries.call: A function, a workflow or a table write. Resolves to its result; a failure carries the API's {errors}.
entries.resource: Rows read from the Data API, with the viewer's permissions.

customDesigner.accessWarning: Fails for {reasons}: they may not read it - Roles › Permissions.

addFields.allOnPage: Every column is on the page
addFields.description: The record's columns not on the page yet - added at the end of the page.
addFields.descriptionIn: The record's columns not on the page yet - added at the end of {widget}.
addFields.title: Add fields

customDesigner.addWidgetDescription: Placed at the end of the area in view.
customDesigner.codeHelp: JavaScript for this page - handlers receive {args} and may be async. Live for viewers once published.
customDesigner.deleteConfirm: Delete this widget and the {n} inside it?

fieldSetup.createVariable: Keep its value in a new variable
fieldSetup.createVariableHelp: A {type} Value the form reads, and code as {code}.
fieldSetup.description: A labelled field around one input.
fieldSetup.sourceColumnHelp: Saved with {code}; PostgreSQL says whether it is required.
fieldSetup.sourceValueHelp: Kept in a Value - for filters and anything not saved as is.
fieldSetup.title: New form field
fieldSetup.variableHelp: Letters, digits and _, starting with a lowercase letter.
fieldSetup.sourceJunctionHelp: Several rows of another table, through a junction table - saved with the record, a junction row per link.

customDesigner.inputHelp: The widget that edits the field's value - changing it keeps the variable it's bound to.
customDesigner.inputFromColumn: Its column's input - it follows the column (Database › the column › Input) while none is picked here.
customDesigner.invalidName: A name is a code identifier: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.
customDesigner.layOutIn: Lay out in {n} column | Lay out in {n} columns
customDesigner.noSelectionDescription: Click a widget on the canvas to edit it.

pageEvents.declared: In your code - go to it
pageEvents.notDeclared: Not in your code yet - add it

customDesigner.pageFooterHelp: pinned under the page: buttons, menus, text, badges and boxes. Empty, there is none.
customDesigner.pageHeaderHelp: buttons and menus here show in the page's header, beside its title.
customDesigner.renameInCode: The Code still says "{name}" - rename it there too.
customDesigner.hiddenMarked: Hidden widgets faded and labeled - show them as the App does
customDesigner.hiddenAsApp: Hidden widgets as the App shows them - fade and label them
customDesigner.resourceWidened: {name} now reads every column of its table - the search window shows and searches them. Drop the ones you don't need in Variables.
customDesigner.openSaveError: Could not save how the form opens

customPage.emptyDescription: Place widgets on it in the Design form.

dataViewCalendarSettings.colorHelp: Optional - falls back to the fixed color below when empty.
dataViewCalendarSettings.dateHelp: Required - a date/timestamp column. Rows are placed on the day this column falls on.
dataViewCalendarSettings.eventDescriptionHelp: Optional - shown when the event is opened.
dataViewCalendarSettings.heading: Calendar settings
dataViewCalendarSettings.noDateColumns: No date/timestamp visible columns - a CALENDAR DataView needs one to place rows.

dataViewCardSettings.cardImageHelp: Optional - a column, or a formula combining several/branching on a value.
dataViewCardSettings.heading: Card settings
dataViewCardSettings.imageFitHelp: Fill crops the edges; whole shows all of it.
dataViewCardSettings.imagePositionHelp: Top keeps a face in a portrait.

dataViewAddColumns.title: Add columns
dataViewAddColumns.intro: The table's columns and, under each foreign key, the columns of the table it points at (read only). The ones already in this DataView are checked.
dataViewAddColumns.unavailable: Its table isn't exposed for reading - its columns can't be added.

dataViewColumnsSettings.copyButtonDescription: A button in the cell copies its value.
dataViewColumnsSettings.empty: No columns yet - use Form design in the header to add some.
dataViewColumnsSettings.heading: Columns
dataViewColumnsSettings.intro: What this DataView reads, and how its grid shows it: order, shown or hidden, header, cell widget and default sort. A hidden column is read but not shown - a layout or a formula can use it, and a viewer can show it. A column not here is never read. Saves as you go.
dataViewColumnsSettings.notSecurity: Not security: each viewer still gets only the columns and rows their roles allow (Roles › Permissions).
dataViewColumnsSettings.keyOnlyFor: {roles} see its key, not the row: their READ on this table lacks {paths} (Roles › Permissions).
dataViewColumnsSettings.notSeenBy: Not seen by {roles}: their READ on this table lacks {column} (Roles › Permissions).
dataViewColumnsSettings.primaryKeyTooltip: Primary key - always read: editing and deleting a row need it. It can be hidden, not removed.
dataViewColumnsSettings.relatedTooltip: A column of the table its foreign key points at - read only, sorted, filtered and searched by its path.
dataViewColumnsSettings.removeHelp: It's no longer read. Add columns… brings it back.
dataViewColumnsSettings.removePrimaryKey: The primary key stays: editing and deleting a row need it. Uncheck it to hide it.
dataViewColumnsSettings.saveOrderError: Could not save the default order/sort

sortHint.none: Not sorted - click to sort ascending

sync.inSyncDescription: No new or renamed columns found.
sync.orphaned: {n} field point at removed columns | {n} fields point at removed columns
sync.orphanedDescription: That column no longer exists on the table - remove the field manually from the Design form's canvas if it's no longer needed.

dataViewColumnsSettings.syncTooltip: Reconcile columns against the table's real, current columns
dataViewColumnsSettings.textWrapDescription: The whole value shows on hover and in the record form. A viewer can change it for themselves from the column's header.
dataViewColumnsSettings.widthDescription: In px. Empty: as wide as its content, up to {max} px.
dataViewColumnsSettings.totalDescription: At the grid's foot: over every row its filters keep, not only the page - PostgreSQL computes it, in this column's format.

dataViewFrameSettings.previewHelp: What viewers see below the header.
dataViewFrameSettings.urlError: Enter an absolute https:// URL of another site, without a user name or password.
dataViewFrameSettings.urlHelp: The https page to embed - fixed for every viewer. It isn't a secret: anyone who can open this DataView can see it. The site must allow being embedded; many refuse, and show a blank frame.

dataViewGanttSettings.barDescriptionHelp: Optional - shown in the bar's tooltip.
dataViewGanttSettings.colorHelp: Optional - falls back to the fixed color below when empty.
dataViewGanttSettings.fewDates: Fewer than two date/timestamp visible columns - a GANTT DataView needs a Start and an End to draw a bar.
dataViewGanttSettings.groupByHelp: Optional - a Foreign Key column. Each row of its related table becomes one swimlane; leave unmapped for one flat timeline.
dataViewGanttSettings.heading: Gantt settings
dataViewGanttSettings.laneOrderHelp: Move up/down to reorder the timeline's swimlanes. A lane the related table gained since this was last saved is added at the end automatically.
dataViewGanttSettings.progressHelp: Optional - a numeric column from 0 to 100. The bar fills up to it.

dataViewTreeSettings.heading: Tree
dataViewTreeSettings.iconHelp: An icon name (i-lucide-folder) for each node.

dataViewKanbanSettings.cardImageHelp: Optional - shown at the top of each card. Assumed to be a URL, or a File Upload column.
dataViewKanbanSettings.groupByHelp: Required - a foreign key, a lane per row of its related table, or a column with a CHECK list, a lane per value in the CHECK's order (labelled, colored and iconed by its presentation's options).
dataViewKanbanSettings.heading: Kanban settings
dataViewKanbanSettings.laneOrderHelp: Move up/down to reorder the board's lanes. A lane the related table gained since this was last saved is added at the end automatically.
dataViewKanbanSettings.noLanes: No lanes yet - pick a Group by column above.
dataViewKanbanSettings.noGroupColumns: No visible foreign key or column with a CHECK list - a KANBAN DataView needs one to group records into lanes.
dataViewKanbanSettings.readOnlyHelp: Cards don't move between lanes - another process sets the column (a function, a workflow).

dataViewLaneColumns.laneColorColumnHelp: Optional - a column on the related table holding a color (a palette name or hex) that marks each lane.
dataViewLaneColumns.laneOrderColumnHelp: Optional - a number column on the related table (e.g. its position). Empty: lanes by name. Moving a lane below still wins.

dataViewMapSettings.colorHelp: Optional - falls back to the fixed color below when empty.
dataViewMapSettings.heading: Map settings
dataViewMapSettings.iconHelp: Optional - falls back to the fixed icon below when empty.
dataViewMapSettings.initialViewHelp: Pan/zoom to where this map should always open - fixed, not auto-fit to the rows.
dataViewMapSettings.popupDescriptionHelp: Optional - shown under the name in the popup.

dataViewPreviewDrawer.description: How users will see it once published - live data, read-only.
dataViewPreviewDrawer.publishNote: Viewers see this draft from now on.
dataViewPreviewDrawer.title: Preview · {name}

dataViewRecordTableSettings.chooseDescription: Optional. The page gets a record of it - {record} - and form fields bound to its columns; a URL's {pk} opens that row. Once chosen it can't be changed.
dataViewRecordTableSettings.heading: Record
dataViewRecordTableSettings.setDescription: The page's record - {record} - and what its form fields are bound to. Set once: those fields point at its columns.
dataViewRecordTableSettings.setError: Could not set the record table

dataViewScopeSettings.columnSetDescription: What this DataView does with a column added to the table after it was created.
dataViewScopeSettings.heading: Scope
dataViewScopeSettings.queryDescription: What this DataView asks the Data API for: fields from Columns, where from the Filter, order_by from the default sort. Each viewer's permissions apply on top.
dataViewScopeSettings.recordsNote: What this query brings, read with your permissions - a viewer's own permissions can narrow it further.

dataViewVersionPreview.opensAsPage: In the App this opens as its own page.

dataViewWizardCalendarStep.colorColumnHelp: Optional - per-row event color. Falls back to the fixed color below when unmapped.
dataViewWizardCalendarStep.dateHelp: Required - a date/timestamp column. Rows are placed on the day this column falls on.
dataViewWizardCalendarStep.defaultColorHelp: Used for every row when no Color column is mapped above.
dataViewWizardCalendarStep.eventDescriptionHelp: Optional - shown when the event is opened.
dataViewWizardCalendarStep.noDateColumns: No date/timestamp visible columns - a CALENDAR DataView needs one to place rows.

dataViewWizardCardStep.imageHelp: Optional - shown at the top of each card. Assumed to be a URL, or a File Upload column.
dataViewWizardCardStep.title: Title

dataViewWizardColumns.intro: The selected columns become the grid's columns and the form's fields - Label and Widget go to both, Help text to the form field. Afterwards each is edited on its own: columns in Settings, fields in Form design.
dataViewWizardColumns.primaryKeyTooltip: Primary key - always read: editing and deleting a row need it. Unchecked, it's hidden.

dataViewWizardGanttStep.barDescriptionHelp: Optional - shown in the bar's tooltip.
dataViewWizardGanttStep.colorColumnHelp: Optional - per-row bar color. Falls back to the fixed color below when unmapped.
dataViewWizardGanttStep.defaultColorHelp: Used for every row when no Color column is mapped above.
dataViewWizardGanttStep.defaultZoomHelp: Which timeline scale this DataView opens to - changeable later from the toolbar.
dataViewWizardGanttStep.fewDates: Fewer than two date/timestamp visible columns - a GANTT DataView needs a Start and an End to draw a bar.
dataViewWizardGanttStep.groupByHelp: Optional - a Foreign Key column. Each row of its related table becomes one swimlane; leave unmapped for one flat timeline.

dataViewWizardTreeStep.noParent: This table has no foreign key to itself
dataViewWizardTreeStep.noParentHelp: A tree needs a column holding each row's parent - a foreign key of the table to its own primary key. Add one in Database > Tables, then come back.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.parentHelp: The foreign key of the table to itself - the row each one sits under.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.orderHelp: A number column ordering the rows under the same parent - renumbered when one is dragged. None: by title.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.cycleGuardHelp: Adds a trigger to the table refusing a row placed under itself or under one of its descendants - for every writer, not only this DataView.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.title: Title
dataViewWizardTreeStep.descriptionHelp: A second line, beside the title in the tree and under it in the org chart.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.imageHelp: An avatar for each node - a photo in an org chart.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.colorHelp: A palette color name or a CSS color - a mark on each node.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.displayHelp: A viewer can switch, and the choice is remembered on their browser.
dataViewWizardTreeStep.expandLevelHelp: How many levels are open when it loads - 0 shows only the top level.

dataViewWizardKanbanStep.cardImageHelp: Optional - shown at the top of each card. Assumed to be a URL, or a File Upload column.
dataViewWizardKanbanStep.groupByHelp: Required - a foreign key, a lane per row of its related table, or a column with a CHECK list, a lane per value.
dataViewWizardKanbanStep.noForeignKeys: No visible foreign key or column with a CHECK list - a KANBAN DataView needs one to group records into lanes.

dataViewWizardMapStep.colorColumnHelp: Optional - per-row pin color. Falls back to the fixed color below when unmapped.
dataViewWizardMapStep.defaultsHelp: Used for every row when no Icon/Color column is mapped above.
dataViewWizardMapStep.descriptionHelp: Optional - shown under the name in the popup.
dataViewWizardMapStep.iconColumnHelp: Optional - per-row pin icon. Falls back to the fixed icon below when unmapped.
dataViewWizardMapStep.initialViewHelp: Pan/zoom to where this map should always open - fixed, not auto-fit to the rows.
dataViewWizardMapStep.nameHelp: Required - the popup's headline when a pin is clicked.
dataViewWizardMapStep.noNumeric: No numeric visible columns - a MAP DataView needs at least two (Latitude/Longitude) to plot anything.

dataViewWizardModal.columnsIntro: Pick which columns of {resource} this view uses.
dataViewWizardModal.cycleGuardError: The DataView was created, but the cycle guard could not be added
dataViewWizardModal.detailColumnsIntro: The columns of {resource} each row shows - in the Detail's grid and in the form that edits a row. All are chosen; uncheck what you don't want. Anything left out can be added later: columns in Settings, fields in Form design.
dataViewWizardModal.detailTableHelp: Its rows are the record's detail - shown in a Detail control, each one edited in a modal you can design afterwards.
dataViewWizardModal.formModeHelp: What this DataView's form opens into - changeable later from Edit DataView.
dataViewWizardModal.manyColumns: This DataView has more than {count} visible columns - a Page usually fits a form this size better than {presentation}.
dataViewWizardModal.masterTableHelp: The table each new record is created in - an invoice, an order.
dataViewWizardModal.modeHelp: How the Edit form opens from the grid - changeable later in Settings.
dataViewWizardModal.noFormFeatures: No form features for this layout yet.
dataViewWizardModal.noRelatedTablesHelp: No table has a foreign key to the master table - a detail table needs one (for example {example}).
dataViewWizardModal.noTableFeatures: No table features for this layout yet.
dataViewWizardModal.previewIntro: What {resource} gives this DataView - the selected columns, always with the primary key. A filter and a default sort come later, in Settings.
dataViewWizardModal.previewNote: What this DataView will read, with your permissions - a viewer's own permissions can narrow it further.
dataViewWizardModal.recordTableHelp: Optional. The page gets a record of it - {variable} - and form fields bound to its columns; a URL's {param} opens that row. Without one, the page edits no record.

designPage.externalFrame: An external frame has no page to design.
designPage.previewTooltip: Preview the draft with live data
designPage.publishConfirmDescription: Viewers see the current draft from now on.
designPage.title: Design

designerClassListEditor.description: Tailwind classes on its box, beyond the options above - mt-6, text-lg, font-semibold, gap-2... The usual spacing, text, border and layout ones always work.
designerClassListEditor.label: CSS classes

designerHtmlAttrsEditor.description: Any other HTML attribute or Nuxt UI prop, by its literal name - a curated one above always wins if it's also set here.
designerHtmlAttrsEditor.label: Custom attributes

displayFormatField.description: Empty: the default for its type. Numbers like #,##0.00, "$ "#,##0.00 or CURRENCY:USD; dates like dd/MM/yyyy.

featuresSettings.autoRefreshDescription: Automatically refresh the grid on an interval - a viewer can still override it with their own ?refresh= URL parameter. A custom interval reads like 45s or 2h.
featuresSettings.contentAlignDescription: Where the form sits on a page wider than it.
featuresSettings.contentWidthCustomDescription: How wide the page's content and its pinned footer grow. Default: Settings > DataViews > Page width.
featuresSettings.contentWidthDescription: How wide the form grows on its page. Default: Settings > DataViews > Page width.
featuresSettings.defaultToolbarHelp: For someone who hasn't chosen their own. A phone or tablet is always compact.
featuresSettings.editModeDescription: How the Edit form opens from the grid - also in the Design form's toolbar.
featuresSettings.firstTimeViewer: What a first-time viewer (or anyone who never personally customized anything) starts with.
featuresSettings.fitToScreenDescription: The form fills the page instead of scrolling it - the row holding a widget with Fill height takes the height left and scrolls inside. Ignored on a phone or a tablet.
featuresSettings.formFeaturesDescription: Edit form behavior and record actions.
featuresSettings.formModeDescription: What this DataView's form opens into.
featuresSettings.newButtonLabelDescription: The start screen's button. Empty: New {name}.
featuresSettings.tableFeaturesDescription: Toolbar and list controls for the DataView.
featuresSettings.headerAlignHelp: How a table's column titles align. Automatic: each one as its column - a number's right, a text's left.
featuresSettings.listMarginHelp: The space around the list - Default: a table takes Settings > DataViews > Table margin, any other list normal.
featuresSettings.toolbarDescription: Shared by every view - each view's layout and own controls are in its tab below.
featuresSettings.kioskDescription: The page alone, filling the screen - no menu and no page header - for a totem or a phone used as a reader. A corner button enters full screen; an administrator leaves the kiosk view from it.

inspector.bindOptionsFirst: {description} Bind its Options to a Resource variable to pick from its fields.
inspector.bindRowsFirst: Bind its Rows to a Resource variable first.
inspector.noRecordTable: This page has no record table.
inspector.noRecordTableColumn: This page has no record table - a page gets one when it is created with a Record table.
inspector.rolesWithoutDashboard: {roles} opens this page but can't see this Dashboard - grant it in the Dashboard's Settings. | {roles} open this page but can't see this Dashboard - grant it in the Dashboard's Settings.

style.stretch: The height of its row (a Card or a Box)

inspector.inheritedStateNone: None - not shown; the column is untouched.
inspector.uploadImage: Upload an image - a public file, anyone who opens the page sees it

settingsPage.designTooltip: Canvas, fields, bindings, events, and code
settingsPage.previewTooltip: Preview the draft with live data
settingsPage.publishNote: Viewers see the current draft from now on.
settingsPage.restoredDescription: Nothing is published yet - publish to make it live.
settingsPage.allowDescription: What its viewers may do besides reading - only less than their permissions, never more: a history listing with no New while the same role creates elsewhere. The Data API still takes what the role may do.

snippetModal.description: Plain code, written for you - read and change it afterwards.
snippetModal.emptyFunctionDescription: A function with a comment saying what it receives - you write its body in the Code.

snippetParamsForm.noControl: No widget of this page has a name that can do this - give it one in its inspector (Name).
snippetParamsForm.noVariable: This page has no {kind} yet - create one in Variables.

useWidgetRuntime.deleteNamesRow: A table delete names its row: "pk" or "where" in the input.
useWidgetRuntime.notAFile: The result is not a file.

useWidgetRuntime.runDelete: Run the delete on {name} for real? It may write data.

variablesPanel.confirmDelete: {name} is used by {users}. Delete it anyway?
variablesPanel.defaultDescription: What it holds when the page opens.

variablesPanel.nameTaken: There is already a variable named {name}

noneSelected.description: Variables hold the page's data and state - create one, then bind widgets to it.
noneSelected.title: No variable selected

notes.noLimit: The query has no limit: here, every matching record; on the page, the Data API's default page (Settings › Data API › Limits).
notes.variablesLeftOut: Conditions reading a page variable were left out - they have no value here.

variablesPanel.recordHelp: A URL's ?pk= opens that row; without one it starts new. Form fields bound to a column edit it; code reaches it as dataview.vars.record - data, mode, dirty, save(values?), new(), reload(), delete()… - and formulas as {formula}.
variablesPanel.workflowDescription: Only MANUAL workflows - they run as the viewer who calls them.
variablesPanel.unusedHint: Used by nothing - perhaps left over

layoutViews.heading: Views
layoutViews.description: The views a viewer switches between from the toolbar, in this order - drag them by their grip. It opens with the main one, or the one the viewer used last.

unavailable.MAP: Needs a point column or two numeric columns (latitude, longitude).
unavailable.KANBAN: Needs a foreign key or a column with a CHECK list to group the cards by.
unavailable.TREE: Needs a foreign key of the table to itself (a parent).

layoutViews.offerHelp: Viewers switch to it from the toolbar.
layoutViews.offerDefault: Always offered - the DataView opens with it.
layoutViews.turnOn: Offer this view to set it up.
layoutViews.sharedDefault: Shared by the Table and Cards views.

settingsLayout.keyColumnHelp: Required - each setting's identifier, never shown (e.g. clave).
settingsLayout.valueColumnHelp: Required - what is edited. A jsonb column picks each control from its value's type: a number, a switch, a date, text.
settingsLayout.titleColumnHelp: Required - the name each setting shows.
settingsLayout.descriptionColumnHelp: Required - the help under its title.
settingsLayout.groupColumnHelp: Optional - one section per group, headed by its name. None: one section.
settingsLayout.orderColumnHelp: Optional - the settings in its order. None: by title.
settingsLayout.heading: Settings layout
settingsLayout.suggest: This table looks like a list of settings (a key and a value) - the Settings type edits it like TotalBase's own Settings.

customDesignerTree.title: Page structure
customDesignerTree.cantDrop: That place doesn't take this widget

actionsSettings.toolbarDescription: The buttons above the list - every view has them.

presentationSettings.heading: Presentation
presentationSettings.description: How the list shows, whichever view: what a first-time viewer starts with, the toolbar, the margin and the refresh.

formSettings.howItOpensDescription: Where a record opens from the list, and a record page's width.

customActions.title: Custom actions
customActions.description: A function or a MANUAL workflow run on a row, the record or a selection - from their menus, without a page. Each shows only to viewers who may run it.
customActions.emptyDescription: Issue or void an invoice, send a reminder to the selected customers.
customActions.panelDescription: What it runs, where it shows and when.
customActions.label: Label
customActions.labelHelp: What the menu says - 32 characters at most.
customActions.functionHelp: A function exposed for calls. A viewer sees the action only with EXECUTE on it.
customActions.workflowHelp: A published MANUAL workflow. A viewer sees the action only if they may run it.
customActions.argsHelp: What each argument gets - a column of the row between double braces, the selection's keys as ids between double braces, or a fixed text. The row's key: {key}.
customActions.workflowDefault: It declares no input fields: it gets the row's key as id - a selection's keys as ids.
customActions.whereHelp: The row's menu, the record form's menu, the bar shown while rows are selected.
customActions.whenHelp: Only on rows this filter holds for - PostgreSQL decides. Empty: always. A selection's action always shows.
customActions.confirmTextHelp: A column of the row between double braces shows its value.
